name: week
title: This week
subtitle: IP Docketing for Claude Code: what needs attention, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Deadlines: missed and the next 14 days
sections.note: Statutory dates lose the right if missed. NOT CHECKED means no second person has checked the date against the source document.
sections.sql: select case_ref, client, attorney, country, deadline, due_on, days_left, coalesce(verified_by, 'NOT CHECKED') as checked_by from docket where statutory and days_left <= 14 order by due_on

sections.title: Renewals needing action
sections.sql: select case_ref, client, country, title, term, due_on, grace_ends_on, state from renewal_book where state in ('lapsed','in grace') or (state in ('reminder due','awaiting instructions','instructed') and days_to_due <= 60) order by due_on

sections.title: Compliance findings
sections.note: Each rule and its source is in docs/compliance.md.
sections.sql: select rule, record, client, finding from compliance_findings order by severity, rule, record

sections.title: By state
sections.sql: select state, count(*)::int as renewals, min(due_on) as earliest from renewal_book group by state order by min(due_on)

sections.title: Every renewal
sections.sql: select case_ref, client, country, case_kind as kind, title, classes, term, due_on, grace_ends_on, state, reminder_sent_on, instruction from renewal_book order by due_on

name: workload
title: Workload
subtitle: Open deadlines by attorney, and the full docket

sections.title: By attorney
sections.sql: select coalesce(attorney, '(none)') as attorney, count(*) filter (where statutory and days_left < 0)::int as overdue, count(*) filter (where statutory and days_left between 0 and 7)::int as this_week, count(*) filter (where statutory and days_left between 8 and 30)::int as next_30_days, count(*) filter (where statutory and verified_by is null)::int as unchecked from docket group by 1 order by 2 desc, 3 desc

sections.title: Full docket
sections.sql: select case_ref, client, attorney, country, case_kind as kind, deadline, due_on, days_left, statutory, rule, verified_by from docket order by due_on
